persons.name: Parthivendramalladeva
persons.evidence: माहाराजद्विराज (sic) चक्रचूडामणि श्री- श्रीश्रीप्रथितुन्द्रमल्लदेव मयूरच्छत्र-खड्गशीर्षिकामनाथं (?) नृपति याकूरधर्माचक्रविजयराज्ये

notes: Bendall notes that the colophon leaf is a later supply-leaf replacing a damaged original. The royal name is corruptly written as 'प्रथितुन्द्रमल्लदेव' (Prathitundramalladeva) for King Parthivendramalladeva of Kathmandu (reigned NS 800–807 / 1680–1687 CE).
